race.comment: The form of MANNERHEIM (2) this time in looks shocking on paper, but all four runs have been at BM62 level or above and you wonder whether any of the rivals here could have got as close as he did in some of those events. Should be at peak fitness now, rise in grade suits and draws the inside. Looks a great each way play. PIANTA (3) doesn't win very often but ran a strong race last time out over 2000m at Bordertown, finishing third and beaten 1.4 lengths. Can play a big role. TAKEMETOTHEMOON (1) was outclassed last start but good in BM62 grade first-up and should be ready to fire third-up at this distance. FUWARI (5) is usually thereabouts but finds it hard to win, with only one victory from 14 starts, but has been placed to advantage here. DEFICIT (10) will have taken great benefit from the fresh run, will relish the extra trip and is a winner here.
